{{Top|leg}}
A '''computer core''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. One was utilized aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Supervisor/Legends|Supervisor]] [[Gurdun]] was overseeing the transfer of one to the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star's]] construction site above [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] when the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was attacked by [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]]. After the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] killed Gurdun and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] escorts, IG-88A uploaded himself to the computer core. Once it was delivered to the Death Star and installed, IG-88A essentially became the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="ig88">{{StoryCite|story=Therefore I Am: The Tale of IG-88|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> The [[Jedi Temple's computer core]] was once possessed by the entity [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
